description: This file defines mock classes and utility functions for using Google Mock (gMock) actions in C++. It includes sample mock class structures, mock method declarations, and helper templates for creating functors from callbacks and bound functions.

classes.name: CallbackToFunctorHelper<R(Args...)>
classes.description: A helper class template that wraps a base::Callback and allows it to be invoked like a functor.

methods.name: CallbackToFunctorHelper(const base::Callback<R(Args...)>& cb)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a callback.

methods.name: operator()(RunArgs&&... args)
methods.description: Invokes the stored callback with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: CallbackToFunctor(const base::Callback<Signature>& cb)
methods.description: Creates a CallbackToFunctorHelper instance from a callback.

methods.name: CreateFunctor(Functor functor)
methods.description: Creates a CallbackToFunctorHelper from a functor.

methods.name: CreateFunctor(Functor functor, const BoundArgs&... args)
methods.description: Creates a CallbackToFunctorHelper from a functor and bound arguments.
